metadata.title: Finite-Shift Inverse-Concavity and Exterior Noncollapsing for Fully Nonlinear Curvature Flows of Nonconvex Hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We give a finite negative-shift criterion for preserving a prescribed exterior noncollapsing bound under fully nonlinear curvature flows whose hypersurfaces need not be convex. The criterion uses the optimized two-point expression of Andrews and Langford. We verify it by a uniform global two-matrix estimate for the explicit speed \[ F_{\varepsilon}(A)= tr A- \varepsilon\frac{\norm{A^{\circ}}^{2}}{ tr A} \] on the open cone \[ \Gamma=\{A\in\Sym(n): tr A>0, \norm{A^{\circ}}< tr A\}.\] Here $A^\circ$ denotes the trace-free part of $A$. This cone contains the positive cone and also matrices with a negative eigenvalue, while the displayed speed is concave and non-convex. For an explicit range of parameters depending on the initial exterior bound, the cone and that bound are preserved throughout the smooth embedded existence interval. Together with the known interior estimate for concave speeds, this gives two-sided tangent-ball bounds for this nonlinear family, including closed nonconvex initial hypersurfaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 为允许非凸超曲面的完全非线性曲率流，提出保持给定外侧非塌缩界的有限负平移判据。
analysis.breakthrough: 对 Fε=tr A−ε|A°|²/tr A 的显式曲率锥验证判据，并结合已知内侧估计得到包含部分非凸初值的双侧切球控制。
analysis.limitations: 参数范围依赖初始外侧界；仅保证光滑嵌入存在区间内保持，不自动给出奇点后的弱流延拓。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确将 Theorem 1.3 中例子的构造协助归给 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Kimi K3，并披露修改表述；这是具体例子的协助而非将所有非塌缩理论归给 AI。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.29852 · PDF 第 19 页 Declarations / AI usage

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确将 Theorem 1.3 中例子的构造协助归给 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Kimi K3，并披露修改表述；这是具体例子的协助而非将所有非塌缩理论归给 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 向非凸、非线性速度扩展非塌缩机制，适合曲率流读者。
